summary: Pacific Airport Group (GAP) filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, reporting preliminary terminal passenger traffic figures for April 2026. The filing shows a 7.6% overall decrease compared to April 2025, with declines at most airports partly attributed to Hurricane Melissa's impact on Jamaican operations. This is a routine operational update with no special-situation transaction, M&A activity, or corporate event. As a foreign private issuer's standard traffic report under Rule 13a-16, it does not trigger any special-situations category. No deal terms, board actions, or advisor roles are involved.
